simple.meaning: אָבַס (ʼâbaç) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to fodder.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 2 times in 1 Kings, Proverbs, beginning at 1 Kings 5:3. The surrounding contexts include family.
